problem_statement: Given a sequence lst and a target value, return the index of the first occurrence of target in lst, or -1 if target is not present.
input_assumptions: lst is a finite indexable sequence (typically a Python list)
Comparison uses standard equality (==) on elements
Return type is int index or -1
expected_output_summary: First index i with lst[i] == target, else -1.
boundary_cases: Empty list (expect -1 unless target matches empty-list convention — confirm per template)
Target at index 0 and at len(lst)-1

provenance.author: phase13_authoring_packet
provenance.notes: Standard linear search semantics; reviewer must align with each template's parameter names and empty-list tests.
